steps.action: Open "Log" (under More on a phone)
user_sees: Title "Log"
Line "Everything done in HQ, and every look at a gym. Nobody can change or delete a line. Kept 2 years."
Columns When, What, Gym, Reason, Who, From, newest first
must_not: A line missing for an action just done
A member name or mobile in any line

steps.action: Scroll to the end and press "Show older"
user_sees: The next 100 older lines added under the first ones
"That is everything." when fewer than 100 came back
must_not: The same lines shown twice
"Show older" offered when there is nothing older

start: All gyms list, one gym opened

steps.action: Open a gym from "All gyms"
user_sees: Card "What HQ did here" with date, action and reason of each HQ action on this gym
"Nothing yet." for a gym HQ never touched
must_not: Another gym's actions in this card

start: Not signed in to HQ, or a broken address

steps.action: Open the HQ log address without an HQ sign-in
user_sees: The HQ sign-in, no log lines
must_not: Any audit line shown to someone not signed in to HQ

steps.action: Open the log with a "before" value that is not a number
user_sees: The newest 100 lines, as if no "before" was given
must_not: An error page
An empty list that hides the log

steps.action: Pause the gym with a reason, then open "Log"
user_sees: A new top line for the pause, with the gym name, the reason and the HQ email
must_not: The pause saved with no log line

steps.action: Open "Log" again later
user_sees: The same line, unchanged, plus a line for each look at the log
must_not: A line edited or removed
The look at the log itself left unrecorded

steps.action: Read the "Who" and "From" columns
user_sees: HQ email and network address of each action, only inside HQ
must_not: A member name, mobile or record in any line
The log open to anyone without the HQ sign-in

steps.action: The gym owner opens the MettleUp access list in the admin app
user_sees: HQ actions on their own gym with the reason (pause, plan, trial, sign-out, new code)
must_not: Another gym's actions
HQ emails or addresses of other gyms

start: HQ signed in, any page; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With HQ audit log saved by the old version, update the app, then do "HQ audit log".
user_sees: The old HQ audit log shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old HQ audit log missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Do step 1 of "HQ audit log" at 23:59 IST and finish after 00:00 IST.
user_sees: The HQ audit log dated on the day the user means, the same on every screen
must_not: The HQ audit log landing on the wrong day, counted twice, or missing from both days

note: Times must read as India time on the HQ page

user_sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back
must_not: A lost HQ audit log, a double HQ audit log after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: "Show older" with no internet must say so and keep the lines already shown
